cohort: 120 women aged 15 to 35 years undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Ondansetron was the most effective in reducing both postoperative nausea and vomiting, followed by propofol, while dexamethasone's preventive effect was not very useful.
mod_finding: Propofol had a beneficial effect in preventing postoperative nausea and vomiting in women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
